newsitem.title: JAPAN: JT plans to raise cigarette prices--paper.
newsitem.headline: JT plans to raise cigarette prices--paper.

text.p: Japan Tobacco Inc (JT) is planning to raise prices of some of its cigarettes to cope with an increase in the consumption tax in April, a Japanese business daily said on Thursday.
Nihon Keizai Shimbun said JT was likely to raise prices of some of its 87 cigarette brands by 10 yen from April.
JT was not immediately available for comment on the report.
The paper said JT would decide details of the price rise by next month to apply to the Ministry of Finance for permission to make the increase.
JT last raised its cigarette prices in 1986, the paper said.
The consumption tax will be increased to five percent from three percent.
